answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a costly, verifiable resource before earning trust, much like basalt foundations that cannot be faked overnight. New identities start with a velvet-soft reputation that grows only through sustained, attested work, so a swarm of cheap copies gains nothing. A single honest sparrow of an agent, building real history over time, outweighs a thousand fresh clones with no stake and no track record.
